summary: Disconnected troubleshooting: 'authentication required' or 'unauthorized' in install-dynamic-plugins means the auth secret is missing or malformed (skopeo ignores cluster pull secrets; use base64 -w0); a duplicated ansible-automation-platform path means imageRegistry includes a repo path; x509 errors need the CA mounted.
questions: Does the portal plug-in installer use cluster pull secrets?

answer_card.title: Air-gapped portal install errors
answer_card.answer_md:
| Symptom (install-dynamic-plugins logs) | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `authentication required` / `unauthorized` | Auth secret missing or malformed; skopeo doesn't use cluster pull secrets | Create `<release-name>-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth`; encode with `base64 -w0` |
| Duplicate path `.../ansible-automation-platform/ansible-automation-platform/...` | `imageRegistry` includes a repository path | Use the host only, or set `ociPluginImage` |
| `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` | Internal/self-signed CA | Mount the CA into the init container |
